prompt: Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 120 words). Collision type: low-speed head-on collision in Katy, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported back strain. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1500; do not mention it.)
text: Driver 1 was traveling southbound in the left lane of a two-lane county road in Katy, Texas, when the vehicle ahead of Driver 1 slowed abruptly. Driver 2, traveling northbound, crossed the center line while attempting to pass a slower vehicle and struck the front of Driver 1's vehicle in a low-speed head-on collision. Both vehicles sustained front-end damage and were not towed from the scene. Driver 1 was the only occupant reporting injury. Driver 1 stated that his neck and lower back were sore immediately after impact and that he experienced stiffness while exiting the vehicle. A Passenger seated in the front right seat of Driver 1's vehicle reported no injuries. Driver 2 denied injury. Both drivers were wearing seatbelts and airbags did not deploy. Emergency medical services were offered; Driver 1 declined transport at the scene. Driver 2 was cited for failure to drive in a single lane. No further hazards were observed.
